response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_remaining_gb) OVER () AS mean_of_avgs FROM g) SELECT site_code, insurance_status, avg_remaining_gb, avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff, avg_remaining_gb / mean_of_avgs AS remaining_ratio FROM m WHERE mean_of_avgs IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: An inner join to sites keeps only processing records whose zoneref matches a site. The 'mean of all groups' average remaining storage' is taken over all groups (all site and insurance-status groups) before the top-10 limit, and groups whose average is NULL are ignored in that mean.
The absolute CPU/GPU difference is computed per record. Records where either value is NULL drop out of that average only. They still count toward the average remaining storage.
